title: OpenDose: curve fitting & biostatistics in your browser (v0.4.0)

author.name: erenozen
author.field: Biomedical lab science: pharmacology, immunoassay, molecular biology and preclinical biostatistics

provenance.origin: github.com/erenozen/opendose at e6f42155dca8, personal (personal: "qpcr" "web app" in:readme,description archived:false (page 1))

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). A spreadsheet-style project workspace like GraphPad Prism where a researcher enters assay data, is guided to the right analysis, and fits dose-response or standard curves or runs t tests, ANOVA, survival and qPCR statistics in the browser with SciPy, getting publication-ready graphs and report text. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
